title: Golden Eagle
subtitle: Aquila chrysaetos
summary: Stooping golden eagle sculpted on an economical 28×28 box-pleated grid with expansive fanned primary feathers, a bilaterally squash-folded tail fan, hooked beak, and razor-thin talons.

title: Winged Pegasus
subtitle: Mythological Winged Stallion
summary: Rearing winged stallion combining broad fanned pinions, a sculpted 3D equine cheek wedge, pricked ears, and straight clip-narrowed limb and neck segments.

title: Triceratops
subtitle: Triceratops horridus
summary: Three-horned ceratopsian dinosaur featuring a broad corner-packed cranial frill shield, twin brow horns, nasal horn, 3D squashed beak rostrum, and four articulated legs.

title: Western Dragon
subtitle: Draco occidentalis
summary: Articulated 26-stick dragon with twin swept horns, open roaring jaws, straight-narrowed neck river, fanned bat-like wings, four clawed legs, and a sinuous whip tail.

title: King Cobra
subtitle: Ophiophagus hannah
summary: Strike-posture cobra rising from a 6-segment coiled base into a squash-flared vertical neck, wide spectacled hood, open lower jaw, and narrowed forked tongue.

title: Emperor Scorpion
subtitle: Pandinus imperator
summary: High-complexity 38-stick arachnid packing eight multi-jointed walking legs, twin open chela pincers, and a five-segment metasoma tail arching forward to a terminal stinger.

title: Boxer Crab
subtitle: Lybia tessellata
summary: Defensive marine crab thrusting two anemone-tipped chelipeds forward from a wide carapace flanked by eight bent walking legs.

title: Bull Moose
subtitle: Alces alces
summary: Forest ungulate crowned with multi-tined palmate antlers, sloped shoulders, angled snout, and four slender legs packed on a compact 34×34 grid.

title: Indian Peacock
subtitle: Pavo cristatus
summary: Displaying peacock raising an eleven-ray semicircular tail train behind an upright neck, crested head, and balanced two-legged stance.

title: Crested Hoopoe
subtitle: Upupa epops
summary: Walking hoopoe featuring an iconic eight-feather radial crown crest, long decurved bill, swept wings, and mid-stride legs.
